findings.title: Health Care's steep valuation gap
findings.body: Health Care trades at a 46% discount on forward earnings versus trailing, the widest gap among sectors. This implies the market expects 86% earnings growth, a bold bet that may already be priced in.

findings.title: Materials' extreme percentile divergence
findings.body: Materials' forward P/E sits at the 44th percentile while trailing is at the 93rd, a 49-point spread. The 119% expected earnings growth underpins this, but the gap suggests high optimism versus recent reality.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' rare cheapness
findings.body: Consumer Staples' forward P/E percentile dropped 23 points in a week, the largest move among sectors. Despite a 48-point gap favoring forward valuations, the sector now sits at its cheapest level in five years.
